messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT — Elevated 5xx rate observed from api-gateway (us-east-1). Alert threshold breached at 2026-03-15T16:23:09Z. Paging oncall: @alice and @bob. Pagerduty incident: PD-2139.

alice: on it. seeing a sustained 502/504 spike starting ~16:21 UTC. surface-level metric: gateway 5xx rate jumped from <0.5% to ~7% for the last 5m.

bob: looking at gateway logs now — quick check: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/api-gateway --since=10m | tail -n 200` shows lots of `upstream timeout` + `upstream reset` messages. grabbing correlation ids.

carla: FYI, we shipped a small gateway retry change in the last canary rollout ~15:50 UTC (rollout id r-2026-03-15-032). Could be related.

alice: timeline so far: 15:50 deploy (gateway retry tweak) -> 16:21 5xx spike begins -> 16:23 alert fired.

bob: sample log lines (redacted):
```
[2026-03-15T16:22:56Z] INFO request_id=abc123 user_id=acct_42 path=/v1/generate upstream=10.0.12.7:8080 error="upstream timeout after 10s"
[2026-03-15T16:22:57Z] INFO request_id=def456 user_id=acct_91 path=/v1/generate upstream=10.0.12.7:8080 error="upstream reset by peer"
```

carla: the upstream (inference-pool v2) logs show long tail latencies and occasional OOM backpressure. `kubectl -n ml logs -l app=inference-pool --since=15m` returning repeated `kv cache miss` and `start generate loop took 9.8s`.

frank: checking autoscaler and node metrics — HPA for inference-pool didn't kick scale until 16:30. CPU was at 70% but GPU utils were high. Might be slow scale due to pod startup times.

erin: customer impact: from the customer error dashboards I can see ~5 customers with >50 errors in that window, and about ~12% of requests serving >5s latencies. Not a full outage but definitely degraded. Opening a support note for the top-3 affected customers.

alice: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) disable gateway retries (we might be amplifying load), 2) increase gateway upstream timeout to 20s temporarily, 3) scale inference-pool to +2 replicas, 4) enable fallback to model v1 if v2 is slow. Who can execute 1 & 2?

bob: I can flip off retries on the gateway config. command: `kubectl -n infra patch cm gateway-config --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/retry.enabled","value":false}]'` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/api-gateway`. Doing it now.

incident-bot: Action logged: `gateway.retries.disabled` by bob at 2026-03-15T16:26:14Z.

carla: increasing upstream timeout in config map too. patching to 20s and restarting gateway to pick up. note: this will increase request tail latency but reduce 5xx.

frank: manually scaling inference-pool now: `kubectl -n ml scale deployment/inference-pool --replicas=6` (was 4). Watching pod startup.

alice: handoff — I've done the initial triage and mitigations. Handing @bob primary for live RCA coordination and next 30m. Please keep me in loop.

bob: taking it. I will track hypotheses and owners below.

bob: Hypotheses (short):
- H1: Retry amplification — gateway retries causing a storm on slow upstream, amplifies load and triggers timeouts (owner: bob)
- H2: Inference-pool v2 regression — model v2 or runtime change causes long tail latencies / OOMs (owner: carla)
- H3: Autoscaler lag / resource starvation — HPA not responsive to GPU pressure (owner: frank)

bob: quick checks in progress: 1) grep correlation ids `abc123/def456` across gateway + inference logs, 2) check recent canary rollout diffs, 3) check pod OOM/kills.

carla: I pulled a trace for request_id=abc123 — trace link: https://traces.internal.redwood/trace/abc123 (internal). From trace: request sat in queue for ~6s, then model warmup + gen ~8s, then upstream timed out at 10s. Looks like a long-tail generation issue.

bob: found amplification pattern: for one request with retries enabled we retried 2x -> created 3 concurrent upstream requests — when upstream slowed we overwhelmed it. This matches H1.

erin: logged impacted customers notified and support has posted temporary mitigation suggestions (retry_disabled + fallback to v1).

bob: current status: gateway retries disabled (done), gateway timeout increased to 20s (done), inference-pool scaled to 6 (in progress), fallback to model v1 ready (carla: can flipover). Observed 5xx rate dropping from 7% -> 1.8% in the last 4m.

carla: preparing the model fallback toggle. command (safe toggle): `POST /admin/models/fallback -d '{"from":"v2","to":"v1","reason":"latency_regression"}'` — will do a canary switch on a small % first.

frank: cluster autoscaling: node pool scaling request queued — provider shows 2 new nodes provisioning, ETA ~4m.

alice: handover note for whoever owns RCA: collect sample traces, exact correlation ids for amplification, config diff for retry change, canary rollout artifact link, and HPA metrics. Also draft a short customer-facing blurb once stabilized.

bob: logging artifacts I'm saving to the incident binder: `/incident/PD-2139/artifacts/gateway_logs.txt`, `/incident/PD-2139/artifacts/inference_traces.json`, `/incident/PD-2139/artifacts/config_diff.patch`.

carla: found a suspicious recent change in runtime: `decoder_kv_cache` patch landed at 15:48 that could increase cold-start generation time. Owner: @carla (investigating).

bob: immediate next steps (owners):
- finalize trace collection + attach to binder (bob)
- root-cause followups on runtime patch (carla)
- autoscaler review and scale tuning (frank)
- customer comms draft (erin)

bob: status update 16:30 UTC — 5xx rate down to 1.2%. We are seeing improved error rates after disabling retries and scaling. Keeping monitoring for 30m.

erin: posted initial customer blurb to PD ticket and support threads: "We're investigating elevated errors impacting requests; temporary mitigations in place; will follow up with RCA."

alice: handing back to bob — I'll stay available for escalation. Please ping if we need rollback.

pagerduty: Incident PD-2139 acknowledged by alice at 2026-03-15T16:25:40Z. Priority: P1.

bob: leaving checklist for the in-incident RCA thread: collect timestamps for threshold breach, correlate correlation_ids to model-instance ids, list exact config lines changed, capture canary artifact hash, and note any customer-visible degradations. I'll convert this to a written RCA after stabilization.

carla: quick note — I saw increased GC/allocator logs in the inference-pool pods around 16:20: `gc pause 200ms` and `allocator stalled` lines — adding to possible runtime regression.

frank: autoscaler logs: `scale-up triggered` at 16:28 but node provisioning delay caused slow capacity — will propose lowering HPA threshold and using faster scale triggers in follow-up.

bob: ok team, current end-of-thread status: mitigations applied, 5xx trending down, active owners assigned for RCA work. Keeping this thread open while we await full stabilization + post-incident notes. Will update binder and schedule a 1hr RCA meeting if needed.

alice: thanks all. good triage. :thumbsup:

bob: (will post final update to this thread when we have RCA notes)
